menu_options.cloud: Sign in to your Glowrium cloud account

cloud.title: Glowrium Cloud Account
cloud.description: Sign in to control devices linked to your account. Separately added Bluetooth lights with the same MAC address share the same Home Assistant entities.

local_confirm.title: Add {name}
local_confirm.description: Model: {model} | Hardware MAC: {mac}. Make sure this is your light before continuing. Local Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) access may not authenticate clients, so other nearby clients may also be able to control it. If the GLOWRIUM app is connected to the light, disconnect it first. Adding this light will not link, activate, or reset it in the cloud.

data.confirm: I confirm this is my light and want to enable local control

reauth_confirm.title: Sign In to Glowrium Again
reauth_confirm.description: Your cloud session has expired. Sign in again with the same account. Separately added Bluetooth lights will continue to work.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Glowrium API
error.wrong_account: Sign in with the account originally used for setup
error.confirmation_required: Confirm the selected light before connecting
error.cannot_connect_bluetooth: Unable to read the light over Bluetooth. Check the distance and disconnect the manufacturer's app.

abort.cloud_unavailable: Glowrium cloud setup is currently unavailable
abort.already_configured: This Glowrium account or Bluetooth light is already configured
abort.no_devices_found: No connectable H1 or H4 device was found. Check your Bluetooth adapter or active Bluetooth proxy, then try again.
